content_sections.heading: About CSRTI Berhampore
content_sections.text: The Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute (CSRTI) is an institute of the Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, located at Berhampore-742101, Murshidabad, West Bengal. The Project Assistant will be engaged under the CSB funded Project PIE02021SIC, titled "Identification and assessment of superior hybrids of polycross population for leaf yield and quality traits in mulberry". The project period is March 2024 to February 2027.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Project Assistant is to be filled. The essential qualification is a pass in Bachelor Degree (B.Sc. / B.Sc. Honours) in Agriculture/Sericulture/Life Sciences/Botany/Zoology from a UGC-recognized University. The notice states that eligible candidates are laid down as per the norms/guidelines of Central Silk Board, Govt of India. Preference will be given to candidates having: Working experience in Mulberry Sericulture Working knowledge in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint etc. The upper age limit is 30 years for Project Assistants, counted on the day of notification. A relaxation of five years is given to SC/ST, women, physically handicapped and OBC candidates as per rules. The Project Assistant gets a consolidated pay of Rs.15000/- per month for candidates with full time B.Sc. Degree/above. The notice does not mention any allowances on top of this pay. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: CSRTI Berhampore Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice describes the nature of the job as: Mulberry crop production and silkworm rearing along with data collection.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates must appear at the walk-in interview with: Biodata A passport size photograph Originals and one copy each of educational qualifications showing SSLC, PUC, BSc and MSc Proof of date of birth (original and one copy) NOC from present employer (if you are employed) Research experience certificate Research papers published in journals (if any) Caste certificate for SC/ST candidates A valid e-mail ID and telephone/mobile numbers

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reach the venue at CSRTI, Berhampur, by 9.30 AM on 30/11/2026. Get your documents verified on arrival. Attend the walk-in interview, which starts at 10.00 AM onwards. Entry of candidates will be permitted only till 12 Noon. Online applications and hard copies of applications will not be accepted or entertained before the interview date, so candidates simply attend on the day with their documents.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary on contractual basis and co-terminus with the project (project period March 2024 – February 2027). Further claim for any post will not be entertained thereafter. No TA/DA will be provided to attend the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. The decision of the Director, CSRTI-Berhampore shall be final and binding in all respects. Candidates may regularly visit www.csb.gov.in or www.csb.gov.in for further information/updates, if any. Address for correspondence: The Director, Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute, Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, Berhampore-742101, Murshidabad Dist, West Bengal, India. Email: [email protected] . The letterhead also gives [email protected] and Director (Landline): 03482-297197.

faq.question: Q1. When is the CSRTI Berhampore Project Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 30 November 2026, from 10.00 AM onwards.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Candidates should reach Central Sericultural Research and Training Institute, Central Silk Board, Berhampur - 742 101, District - Murshidabad, West Bengal, by 9.30 AM for verification of documents; entry is permitted only till 12 Noon.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one (1) post of Project Assistant under the CSB funded Project PIE02021SIC.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the CSRTI Berhampore Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: A pass in Bachelor Degree (B.Sc. / B.Sc. Honours) in Agriculture/Sericulture/Life Sciences/Botany/Zoology from a UGC-recognized University is essential. Preference goes to candidates with working experience in Mulberry Sericulture and working knowledge of MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 30 years, counted on the day of notification. SC/ST, women, physically handicapped and OBC candidates get a relaxation of five years as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The pay is a consolidated Rs.15000/- per month for candidates with full time B.Sc. Degree/above.

faq.question: Q7. Which documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring biodata, a passport size photograph, originals and one copy each of SSLC, PUC, BSc and MSc certificates, date of birth proof, NOC from present employer if employed, research experience certificate, research papers (if any), caste certificate for SC/ST candidates, and a valid e-mail ID and phone number.

faq.question: Q8. How will the Project Assistant be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates first undergo verification of documents on arrival, followed by the walk-in interview from 10.00 AM onwards on 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSRTI Berhampore Project Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely temporary on contractual basis and co-terminus with the project (March 2024 – February 2027), and further claim for any post will not be entertained thereafter.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be provided to attend the interview.
